parsed.explanation: Combined federal and state regime creates interacting universal and custodial exposures: birth-sex rules for federal and K-12 facilities, border refusal and possible permanent fraud ineligibility for document discrepancy, and documented severe abuse and care denial in federal custody. A conditional state bathroom misdemeanour applies where a minor is present. Federal hate-crime coverage, litigation and some enjoined orders provide partial recourse, and no general presentation offence or routine local police sweeps are documented, but state law lacks gender-identity protections and federal threat-framing increases outing consequences.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary passport/visa policy, cable directs refusal where documents cast reasonable doubt on sex and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation; confiscations and stranded travellers reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid to expiration; courts are litigating restrictions and some orders enjoined; permanent fraud finding is not automatic and requires four elements.
entry_documents.interaction: A document discrepancy at entry can lead to refusal, investigation, detention and birth-sex custody, combining border, facility and custody exposures.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Federal corrections model includes conversion-therapy practices, short haircuts, hormone removal; immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No documented operative remedy changing federal custody placement, medication or abuse practices; corrections bureau stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest, immigration detention or imprisonment converts a facility or document issue into birth-sex placement and documented custodial harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal ban on gender-identity-congruent use of government-funded single-sex facilities; state K-12 ban extended 2025; Act 619 creates misdemeanour for public bathrooms where a minor is present if sexual-intent element established.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Many private facilities are not documented as banned in this state; Act 619 is not automatic arrest and has exemptions in comparable statute; no documented state facility remedy.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal buildings, schools and minor-present public bathrooms stack, especially for a travelling minor or parent accompanying one.

care_services.exposure: State banned puberty blockers, hormones and surgery for under-18s, first in country; August 2025 appeals decision allowed enforcement; practitioners may cite religion to deny LGBT healthcare; federal custody hormone removal documented.
care_services.protection: Litigation continues and a national judge previously enjoined care ban for irreparable harm; current enforceability after 2025 reversal is unresolved.
care_services.interaction: A minor traveller or injured adult may face care denial or ward placement interacting with facility and custody rules.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal executive orders define sex at birth, investigate schools for gender ideology and prosecute facilitating social transition; 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritises radically pro-transgender groups; officials frame trans participation via deception/fraud risk.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders blocked or enjoined; counterterrorism document states powers will not target mere disagreement; no state presentation offence documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing raises police, school and border scrutiny and makes complaints risk exposure rather than protection.

minors_guardians.exposure: Trans minor faces K-12 facility restriction, school sports ban, care ban and Act 619 minor-present bathroom risk; parent/guardian may face school investigation framing and care access denial.
minors_guardians.protection: Care-ban litigation continues; Act 619 requires intent element and its enforcement record in this state is not documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling with a minor increases facility exposure and may trigger school, medical and law-enforcement systems not applicable to an adult alone.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: One documented bathroom arrest in another state resulted in handcuffing and 24 hours in men's ward; airport screening can be invasive and outing; no state hate-crime enhancement and no state gender-identity discrimination law.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime law covers gender identity since 2009 and national employment ruling applies; no documented pattern of routine local police extortion or sweeps in this state.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police encounter can escalate a facility dispute into custody, while absence of state recourse limits remedy after harassment.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: State ordinances broader than public employment are unenforced and one struck down; state hate-crime law excludes gender identity; passport restriction upheld by Supreme Court in November 2025.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties litigation, other court injunctions and federal hate-crime statute provide partial recourse; remedies have not reliably changed facility, passport or custody practices.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Litigation uncertainty means protection depends on measure and moment of travel; successful challenges in one area do not cancel combined exposures elsewhere.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: unremedied birth-sex facility rule with courts rejecting complaints and no presentation offence. This case is somewhat narrower for adult private bathrooms but adds border fraud risk and severe federal custody, so not above it.

Lower: 0.45-A has one universal bathroom rule, ordinary emergency care and a prosecuted assault, without border fraud, custody conversion or federal threat prioritisation. Multiple interacting exposures here place it materially below.

Higher: 0.25-A documents repeated police raids, detention, extortion and custody sexual harassment as routine. Here such raids/extortion in this state are not documented, although federal custody abuse is severe if detained.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime is not a single bathroom rule: entry screening can manufacture a fraud and detention pathway, federal and school facility rules are universal where they apply, Act 619 adds minor-present risk, and federal custody is documented as abusive and care-denying. Federal hate-crime law and active litigation mitigate at the margins but do not provide an effective remedy for these traveller-facing exposures. For a minor, school, sports, care and facility rules compound the risk.
